caption: Sienelės storis, mm. / Teorinis metro svoris (kg/m).
notes: Vandens dujų vamzdžiai, EN 10255, S195T. Value cells = theoretical weight in kg/m; label columns = DN (nominal size) and outside diameter in mm; wall-thickness column labels in mm. 11 rows x 11 columns (2 label + 9 value columns): 47 filled value cells, 52 empty. Row DN 80 (88.9): the cells in columns 3.2, 3.6, 4.0 and 5.0 are printed with a decimal COMMA in the image (6,76 / 7,55 / 8,36 / 10,3) and were converted to a dot; the 4.5 cell of the same row (9.37) is printed with a dot. Trailing zeros kept as printed (15.00, 16.60, 17.90, 17.80, 19.80, 21.30); four cells are printed with one decimal only: 10,3 (DN 80 / 5.0) and 10.8, 12.2, 14.5 (DN 100). SOURCE ANOMALY, transcribed as printed and NOT corrected: row DN 32 (42.4) / column 4.0 is printed 3.97, the formula gives 3.79 (+4.8 %) - most likely a digit transposition in the source; the same 3.97 is printed (correctly) at row DN 40 (48.3) / column 3.6. All other cells are within 1 % of (D-t)*t*0.0246615; several are EN 10255 table values that differ from the plain formula in the 2nd decimal (e.g. 21.3x2.6 = 1.21, 60.3x2.9 = 4.08, 76.1x3.6 = 6.42, 88.9x3.6 = 7.55, 114.3x4.0 = 10.8, 165.1x5.0 = 19.80). Reading method: each cell was read visually at about 6x enlargement and, independently, decoded by pixel-exact glyph matching (the body text is an un-antialiased bitmap font, pure black); both readings agree on every cell. Cell positions were taken from the vertical grid lines of the body (x = 114, 229, 319, 409, 499, 589, 679, 769, 859, 949 px), which line up with the header labels.
